entry in `project/tasks-rotation.json` cleared it. See [`INDEX.md`](INDEX.md) for which.

Three differences from [[T149]]'s typecheck-ratchet, all forced by the security shape: **`--save` never accepts a NEW surface** (it locks in improvements on declared ones and prints a paste-ready stanza — a ratchet that auto-accepts what it finds ratifies the breach it exists to catch); **every entry needs a written `reason`** or exit 2 (a list of ports without reasons is a rubber stamp); and **`status: known-open` vs `accepted`** — the two live findings are RECORDED, not laundered, and print red every run. 📅 **AC6 cadence = `just audit` (T96), outside `--quick`** — and the placement IS the enforcement, because `--quick` is the pre-push subset, so AC6's *'never a push gate'* is a property of the call site, not a comment. Retiring the ratchet did **not** unwire it: an empty baseline is still exit 2, accepted only with explicit `retired` + `graduated`, and the step now asserts every graduate is **still** in `just typecheck` (5 red probes). ⚠️ Two ts(6385) hints left **on purpose** — the deprecated supabase singleton in `interview/[id].astro`, already listed by `just authz-admin-client` and owned by [[T327]], whose module docstring says *"Migrate per-caller, WITH an auth check added. | [T208](project/tickets/T208.md) | **P1** | **`user_profiles` is queried but was never created — the half of the ghost-caller problem [[T194]] cannot see** — 🔻 **narrowed from 9 sites to 2 the same day it was filed:** 7 of the 9 were already **[[T194]]'s**, by file and line, since 2026-08-10 (`linkedin_tokens` was **dropped** by `20260721120000_t99…:63`; replacement `public.social_integrations` **exists**, and its columns are **plaintext at rest** per [[D1]] — context this ticket did not have). I filed before checking the queue. 🔑 **Why it survives as its own ticket:** T194's gate derives its worklist from `DROP` statements in the migrations, and **`user_profiles` appears in no migration at all** — never created, so never dropped, so a drop-derived gate is blind to it by construction. `just callsite-drift` finds it by comparing against the **live catalog**. Two gates, complementary blind spots. 🔴 **Remaining 2 sites:** `handlers.ts:438` writes `linkedin_sub`/`github_sub` after OAuth inside a `catch {}` commented *"swallow so a linking hiccup never blocks sign-in"* ⇒ provider linking has **never** persisted; and `linkedin-data-erasure.ts:54`. 🔻 **TWO CORRECTIONS 2026-08-13, same day this row was written:** (1) the erasure path does **NOT** report success — it `throw`s on the first error, and because step 1 targets a dropped table it **always fails there and never reaches steps 2-3**, so `job_applications` PII is never scrubbed and **no erasure has ever completed** (worse than the silent-success I first claimed, and a different defect); (2) **`public.profiles` is NOT the target — it has no `*_sub` column at all.** The real supersessor is **`public.social_integrations`**, whose `(provider, provider_urn)` pair IS the linkage, already written by the live `linkedin-oauth` edge fn ⇒ a re-point to a different SHAPE, not a rename. | web(web), api | T69 callsite-drift | ✅ **done** |
